summary: Completed testing of iteration 31 features: Button color swap on leads page, White Label branding, SLA shields on contracts, Client achievements (SLA, tenure, loyalty), Portal readiness score, Loyalty dashboard with tier rankings, and Smart contract auto-renewal proposals. All 10 backend API tests passed (100%). Fixed route ordering issue for /api/contracts/auto-renewal-proposals endpoint. UI testing confirmed all new features work correctly.

fixed.issue: Route was being matched by /api/contracts/{contract_id} due to path ordering. Fixed by adding auto-renewal-proposals route to contracts.py before {contract_id} route

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in FastAPI matters - static paths must be defined before dynamic {id} paths. Similar fix applied in iteration 30 for /tickets/active-viewers.
updated_files: /app/backend/app/routers/contracts.py - Added /contracts/auto-renewal-proposals route before {contract_id} route to fix path matching

leads_button_colors.details: Create Ticket = GREEN (emerald-600), Convert to Client & Create Ticket = PURPLE (purple-600), Convert to Client Only = OUTLINE style

white_label_branding.details: Page loads with 4 tabs (General, Invoices, Contracts, Letterhead). Company name input, logo uploaders, and 3 color pickers (primary, secondary, accent) all working. GET/PUT /api/settings/branding endpoints verified.

sla_shields_contracts.details: SLA column visible in contracts table with shield icons and tier labels (Standard, Gold, Silver, Bronze, Platinum). SLA tier saved correctly on contract creation.

client_achievements.details: Awards tab shows 3 achievement types: SLA Shields (5 tiers with shield icons), Tenure Milestones (1yr-20yr with progress), Loyalty Badges (First Ticket, Power User, etc). 2/16 earned for test client.

portal_readiness.details: Ready tab shows Portal Readiness Score (50% for test client) with progress circle. 8 checklist items with green/red status indicators.

loyalty_dashboard.details: Loyalty Tiers tab shows 4 tier cards (Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze) with client counts. Client Loyalty Rankings list shows ranked clients with points and tier badges.

auto_renewal_proposals.details: Auto-Renewal Proposals tab shows MRR summary cards (Current MRR, Potential MRR, Upsell Potential). Shows 'No contracts expiring in next 60 days' when none pending. API returns proposals with upsell opportunities.

sidebar_navigation.details: New nav items visible: 'Loyalty & Renewals' (Gift icon) and 'White Label' (Paintbrush icon) in sidebar

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed contract with Gold SLA during backend testing for SLA shield verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 31 features verified working. Backend API fix applied for /api/contracts/auto-renewal-proposals route ordering. White label branding stores settings in MongoDB settings collection with type='branding'. Client achievements include 3 types: SLA shields, tenure milestones, loyalty badges. Portal readiness checks 8 items (contact, email, phone, address, devices, contracts, logo, industry). Loyalty points calculated as: tickets*5 + invoices*10 + total_paid/100 + contracts*50.
